name: Exiled Prince
source:
Axel Syrios' Doppelganger

Though his easy going disposition may be misleading, no one enjoys chaos quite as much as the exiled prince of the Fire Plane. He is a powerful flame devil, and was the next in line to rule when his father dominated all of the other Elysium. Things went awry for him when the demon king of the Ice Plane assassinated his father and stole a great source of power- the cursed flame shard. However, he now looks forward to taking the world back for himself with a carefree attitude and thinks it will be an exciting development for everyone.

[Edited from in-game profile]
